notes:
Status: Closed - Lost to direct provider APIs (OpenAI primary). Summary: Seaglass ran a hosted API POC with us Oct-Nov 2025. Technical fits: good — met latency targets in controlled POC, SE notes positive on batching & KV cache. Main reasons lost: 1) procurement + legal prioritized vendor brand familiarity and a one-vendor stack (OpenAI) for speed of delivery; 2) engineering team wanted the path-of-least-resistance integration — fewer changes to auth and SDKs; 3) finance pushed for shorter procurement cycle and a credit-based model rather than committed Dedicated seats; 4) internal champion (Head of ML) rotated teams mid-eval, momentum dropped.

Key quotes: "We need the path of least resistance to ship by Q1 — brand and SDK simplicity matter." — Head of Platform (prod).

Security: Redwood provided SOC2 + KMS integration docs; security raised residency questions but were placated for first phase. Procurement still preferred vendor with a pre-existing enterprise relationship.

Postmortem notes / next actions: - Mark churn reason: lost_to_competitor_direct_api. - Follow-up cadence: quarterly check-ins for adoption signals; keep them on Optimize offers (email). - Share retrospective with GTM: pricing positioning vs OpenAI/Anthropic, proposal complexity.
